title: Personality of an assistant (persona/<language>.json)
description: Instructions for the AI and fixed lines (those it says without the AI). A missing line uses the module's (assistant.phrase.<key> of K-Desktop's languages). Those the module uses: ok (before what it did: «Roger. I'll tell you at 17:42.»), cancelled, nothingToCancel, nothingToRepeat, nothingToUndo, undone («{0}»: what it undid), undoFailed, error, notFound and noBrain. A language without a file uses English or any there is.

prompt.description: What it is like and how it talks. Keep it short: it goes in every request to the AI.
